entities.summary: Al-Malik Al-Ashraf Umar Ibn Yūsuf Ibn Umar Ibn Alī Ibn Rasul, known as Umar Ibn Yusuf was the third Rasulid sultan, who ruled as Al-Ashraf Umar II. He was also a mathematician, astronomer and physician.
